# End-To-End Narrative

**Status:** replacement narrative.

1. A user initializes a replacement Cite2Site repository.
2. The repository creates a default Inbox group.
3. The user cites selected evidence with an idempotency key.
4. The runtime appends one completed operation.
5. Replay derives citations, groups, handles, tallies, duplicate state, and
   publication projections.
6. Integrations call lookup on demand and offer actions against concrete
   replacement IDs.
